discovery.name: Fresh Bamboo Shoot
discovery.description: Crunchy, sweet and still dewy. I packed three in my satchel for later. Okay, two. Okay, I ate them all.

discovery.name: Rhododendron
discovery.description: A whole hillside of pink and red blossoms! I tucked one behind my ear. It keeps falling into my hat.

discovery.name: Rope Bridge
discovery.description: It wobbles. I wobble. We wobbled across together, and nobody looked down. Except me. Once.

discovery.name: Tea Leaf
discovery.description: The tea pickers showed me how to pluck two leaves and a bud. My paws are slow but very careful.

discovery.name: Prayer Flags
discovery.description: Blue, white, red, green and yellow, fluttering kind wishes out over the valley. I sent one for you.

discovery.name: Golden Langur
discovery.description: A monkey with fur like sunset honey watched me from a branch. I waved. It did not wave back. Rude, but beautiful.

discovery.name: Yak
discovery.description: Big, shaggy and very calm. It let me rest in its shadow while it chewed. Best nap of the trip.

discovery.name: Hot Spring
discovery.description: Warm water bubbling out of the rocks! I soaked my tired paws until my tail went all fluffy with steam.

discovery.name: Stone Cairn
discovery.description: Travelers stack stones here to say they made it. I added a tiny one at the top. It is my best work.

discovery.name: Himalayan Monal
discovery.description: A bird shimmering in every color at once, like someone spilled a rainbow on a pheasant. I gasped out loud.

discovery.name: Snow Leopard Track
discovery.description: Paw prints bigger than my whole face, pressed into fresh snow. I followed them for a bit. Then, very politely, I did not.

discovery.name: Himalayan Blue Poppy
discovery.description: Up where hardly anything grows, a poppy as blue as the sky. We made it to the top together. Thank you for every step.
